page_title: ATA 3-0 TOR | Atalanta v Torino 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Torino.
90+1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
89' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it.
86' Substitution. Marco Carnesecchi walks off the pitch and Francesco Rossi (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
85' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Duvan Zapata and he is replaced by David Okereke (Torino).
85' The substitution has been made. Zannetos Savva (Torino) has replaced Karol Linetty.
83' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
82' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

81' Ooh that was close! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
79' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. Torino are awarded a free kick.
77' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
77' Isak Hien (Atalanta) receives a yellow card.
76' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
73' Here is a change. Gianluca Scamacca is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to El Bilal Toure (Atalanta).
73' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Torino win a free kick.
73' That will be all from Charles De Ketelaere who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
72' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Adrien Tameze is replaced by Matteo Lovato (Torino).
71' Here comes a substitution. Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Raoul Bellanova.
71' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Luca Gemello no chance!
70' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
70' Simone Sozza blows his whistle after Adrien Tameze (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee gives a penalty to Atalanta!
68' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
68' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
66' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Simone Sozza due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and his team.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pietro Pellegri trots off the pitch and is replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) is coming onto the pitch as Emil Holm cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Isak Hien (Atalanta) replacing Berat Djimsiti.
61' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Luca Gemello thwarted him with a fabulous save.
60' Duvan Zapata (Torino) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
58' The foul by Karol Linetty (Torino) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simone Sozza.
57' Torino fail to score from a corner as Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) leaps to collect the ball.

56' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
56' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece. Torino earn a free kick.

55' The game is interrupted. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. There is a free kick near the sideline to Torino.
54' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Luca Gemello, who smothers the ball.
51' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Atalanta.
50' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

49' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

49' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Atalanta won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Torino win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
47' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
46' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

46' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Simone Sozza has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+1' Ivan Ilic (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
45+1' Simone Sozza blows the whistle, Emil Holm (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 2 - 0 Goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
43' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Luca Gemello.
42' Duvan Zapata (Torino) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Carnesecchi, who pulls off a stunning save!
41' What a big chance! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
40' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is adjudged offside.
40' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
37' A player from Atalanta takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Torino will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
36' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Simone Sozza had a clear view and blows his whistle. Atalanta have been awarded a free kick.
35' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

34' Ivan Ilic (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' A pass from Pietro Pellegri (Torino) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
32' Torino have a free kick.
32' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Simone Sozza blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Torino.
30' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
26' 1 - 0 Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the right post. What a lovely finish!

24' What a big chance! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
22' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Torino are awarded the free kick.
21' Adam Masina (Torino) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Adam Masina (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Duvan Zapata (Torino) heads on.
17' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Torino was in an offside position.

16' That didn't go as planned! Emil Holm (Atalanta) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Luca Gemello, who easily kept it out.

15' Duvan Zapata (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' Half-chance! Ivan Ilic (Torino) plays a pass into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' Duvan Zapata (Torino) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
10' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
10' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
9' Ivan Ilic (Torino) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
8' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Torino, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
6' Adrien Tameze (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' The free kick from close range, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Simone Sozza blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simone Sozza.
